confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderate confidence; July hostel and hotel rates are least certain because demand swings. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer-price relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. FX observation came from search-result summaries of the RBA table, not a direct page read; verify on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Nordic capital peers: generally below Oslo and Copenhagen and broadly similar to Stockholm. Euro amounts converted to USD at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR (not searched).
